_about: WhatsApp templates that open the conversation when the owner hasn't messaged in 24 hours. Read by src/lib/openers.ts (sending) and scripts/whatsapp-templates.mjs (creating them in Twilio and submitting them to Meta). Meta rules: no variable at the very start or end, sample values for every variable. Changing the wording means a new name (_v2) and a new approval.

brief.name: dinerai_brief_ready_v1
brief.body: Good morning {{1}}. Your DinerAI brief for {{2}} is ready: {{3}}. Tap below to see it.

review.name: dinerai_review_alert_v1
review.body: Hi {{1}}, {{2}} has a new {{3}}-star Google review. I've drafted a reply for you to check.

feedback.body: Hi {{1}}, a customer rated their visit to {{2}} {{3}} out of 5 and left a private note. Tap below to read it.
